var scene = get_tree().current_scene
Engine.max_fps = 120
var key = InputEventKey.new()
key.keycode = KEY_TAB
key.pressed = true
Input.parse_input_event(key)
await get_tree().process_frame
var angles = [-108.0,-144.0,180.0,144.0,108.0,72.0,36.0,0.0,-36.0,-72.0]
var angle = deg_to_rad(angles[scene.prompt_idx])
var vector = Vector2(cos(angle),-sin(angle))*0.95
for values in [vector,Vector2.ZERO]:
	for axis in [JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X,JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_Y]:
		var event = InputEventJoypadMotion.new()
		event.device = 0
		event.axis = axis
		event.axis_value = values.x if axis == JOY_AXIS_RIGHT_X else values.y
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
	for frame in range(3):
		await get_tree().process_frame
var before = {"mode":scene.mode,"hits":scene.discrim_hits,"total":scene.discrim_total}
key = InputEventKey.new()
key.keycode = KEY_TAB
key.pressed = true
key.echo = true
Input.parse_input_event(key)
await get_tree().process_frame
var after = {"mode":scene.mode,"hits":scene.discrim_hits,"total":scene.discrim_total}
key = InputEventKey.new()
key.keycode = KEY_TAB
key.pressed = false
Input.parse_input_event(key)
return {"before_repeat":before,"after_repeat":after,"scope":"One successful prompt followed by a held-Tab repeat event"}
